connections.grantsEmpty: No agent uses this connection yet.

connections.agentsEmpty: No agent uses a connection yet.
connections.errorBody: Try again in a few minutes.
connections.forbiddenTitle: Only owners and managers can manage connections
connections.forbiddenBody: Ask an owner or manager to add or change a connection.

connections.tgStepsTitle: How to get a bot token (about 2 minutes)
connections.zaloCheckOk: The Zalo OA tokens are valid.
connections.noAgentHint: No agent is bound to this connection, so its messages are not answered. Use the Attach to an agent button on this row (or the agent's Permissions tab).
connections.noAgentHintBank: No agent is bound to this connection, so no agent can read its incoming transfers yet. Use the Attach to an agent button on this row (or the agent's Permissions tab).
connections.checkOk: Telegram has this connection's webhook registered. Waiting updates: {pending}.
connections.checkNotRegistered: Telegram does not have this connection's webhook yet. Press Disconnect and connect again, or check the site address.

connections.localNote: Local site: the connection is saved, but Telegram can only reach you once the app runs on its public domain. The webhook is registered there.

connections.attentionImpact: Agent {names} cannot use this connection for now.
connections.libEmptyHint: Try another word or clear the filters. Tell us what you need with Want it on a planned connector.
connections.detailWanted: Noted. We build the most wanted connectors first.
connections.detailSoon: This connector is planned. Press Want it and we will build the most wanted ones first.
connections.connectedEmptyHint: Open the Library to connect a payment feed, a chat channel or a data source.
connections.attentionPending: Setup is not finished. Continue where you left off.
connections.attentionError: This connection stopped working. Open it to fix it.
connections.disconnectBody: Agents using it stop receiving its messages or payments. You can connect it again later.
connections.removeBody: The connection and its saved keys are deleted. This cannot be undone.
connections.emptyAllBody: Start with the bank feed, so agents see money arriving.
connections.provider_openapi_blurb: Pick the CRM and give its API address: NIVO reads the CRM's Swagger and generates the APIs for agents, screens and MCP.
connections.provider_database_blurb: PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server, read only: pick the customer, order and product tables NIVO syncs.
connections.provider_csv_import_blurb: Upload an Excel or CSV list of customers, orders or products; map the columns once, upload again to update.
connections.provider_imap_blurb: Reads incoming mail of the mailbox you choose (read only) so agents see requests, orders and invoices sent by email.
connections.provider_telegram_user_blurb: Reads the chats you pick on a personal Telegram account. Read only, disconnect any time.
connections.provider_sepay_blurb: Money in and out of your bank account is reported to NIVO by SePay; agents can read it and get a QR code for transfers.
connections.guide_sepay_basic_2_option: Both money in and money out
connections.guide_sepay_basic_4_label: Tự động gửi lại khi server trả lỗi
connections.guide_sepay_security_2_text: Leave the remaining steps as they are, then press Save.
connections.verify_sepay_test_intro: Money in test mode is not real.
connections.verify_sepay_test_0: On SePay, turn on the Test Mode switch at the top right.
connections.verify_sepay_test_1: Open Transactions and press Simulate transaction.
connections.verify_sepay_test_2: Pick the account {bank} · {account}, enter 2,000 and create the transaction.
connections.verify_sepay_live_intro: A small real transfer is the surest way to know it works.
connections.verify_sepay_live_0: Transfer a small amount, for example 2,000 VND, into the account {bank} · {account} from another bank or wallet.
connections.provider_payos_blurb: NIVO creates, reads and cancels payOS payment links; paid transactions are reported to agents.
connections.provider_payos_noTest: NIVO knows of no separate test mode in payOS, so only Live is available. Try it with a small amount.
connections.guide_payos_channel_2_text: Name it and pick the bank account that receives your money on payOS, then create the channel.
connections.guide_payos_webhook_1_text: NIVO asks payOS to confirm this address when you press Save keys. If the channel has a Webhook URL box you can paste it there too.
connections.verify_payos_live_intro: A small real order is the surest way to know it works.
connections.verify_payos_live_0: Create a small payment link, for example 2,000 VND, on payOS.
connections.verify_payos_live_1: Pay that link with your banking app.
connections.provider_casso_blurb: Money arriving in your bank account is relayed by Casso to NIVO; agents can read it.
connections.provider_casso_noTest: NIVO knows of no separate test mode in Casso, so only Live is available. Try it with a small transfer.
connections.guide_casso_setup_1_hint: Casso generates this key. Copy it from Casso and paste it here.
connections.guide_casso_setup_2_text: Press Save on Casso to finish the integration.
connections.verify_casso_live_intro: A small real transfer is the surest way to know it works.
connections.verify_casso_live_0: Transfer a small amount, for example 2,000 VND, into the account {bank} · {account} from another bank or wallet.
connections.provider_telegram_blurb: Customers message your own bot; the Chatbot agent answers them.
connections.guide_telegram_botfather_0_text: Open Telegram and search for @BotFather (the official account with the blue tick).
connections.guide_telegram_botfather_2_text: Give your shop's bot a name and a username (the username must end in bot).
connections.guide_telegram_botfather_3_text: BotFather replies with a long token like 123456:ABC-DEF... Copy all of it.
connections.provider_zalo_oa_blurb: Customers message your shop's Zalo Official Account; the Chatbot agent answers them.
connections.guide_zalo_oa_app_0_text: Open developers.zalo.me, sign in with the Zalo account that administers your shop's OA, and create a new app.
connections.guide_zalo_oa_app_2_text: Copy the App ID and the app's secret key (App Secret) from the general settings and paste them into NIVO.
connections.guide_zalo_oa_link_1_text: Link your shop's Official Account to this app (your account must be an administrator of the OA).
connections.guide_zalo_oa_link_3_text: Under Permissions, request message management, follower information and consultation messages.
connections.guide_zalo_oa_webhook_1_label: Sự kiện: Người dùng gửi tin nhắn văn bản (user_send_text)
connections.guide_zalo_oa_webhook_3_hint: Zalo shows this key on the Webhook page. NIVO uses it to check that every message Zalo sends is genuine.
connections.provider_meta_blurb: Customers message or comment on your Facebook Page and Instagram account; agents answer, and lead-ad leads land straight in NIVO.
connections.provider_webhook_blurb: NIVO sends events (new customer, order, payment...) to n8n, Make, Zapier or any address you choose.
connections.guide_webhook_n8n_0_text: In n8n add a Webhook node: Method POST, then copy the Production URL.
connections.provider_google_blurb: Connect your Google account so NIVO can record orders in your spreadsheet.
connections.errWebhookRefused: The token is valid, but Telegram refused the webhook address.
connections.errZaloTokenRefused: Zalo refused this OA's token. Connect the OA again.
connections.errTokenRejected: Telegram refused this token. Check that you copied the whole token from @BotFather, or create a new one with /token.
connections.errTokenFormat: This does not look like a Telegram bot token. A token looks like 123456789:AAE... - copy it again from @BotFather.
connections.errBotInUse: This bot is connected in another workspace. Disconnect it there first, or create a new bot with @BotFather.
connections.errNetwork: Could not reach the service. Check the network and try again.
connections.errGoogleRevoked: The access was revoked in your Google account. Grant it again.
connections.errStopped: This connection stopped working. Open its page to see how to fix it.
connections.provider_google_drive_blurb: Documents in the folders you choose.
connections.provider_smtp_blurb: Send reports, receipts and payment reminders from your own shop email.

connectorCsv.title: Import data
connectorCsv.fieldNameHint: For example Customers 2026. You can create as many imports as you need.
connectorCsv.sourceFileBody: Upload a .xlsx or .csv file. Upload again later to update the same import.
connectorCsv.sourceSheetBody: A sheet shared with anyone who has the link. NIVO can read it again on a schedule.
connectorCsv.sourceManualBody: Paste a table copied from Excel or type rows into a small grid.
connectorCsv.sourceDocumentBody: Word, PDF, text or Markdown files, or a Google Docs link. Each becomes a document.
connectorCsv.filePrompt: Drop a .xlsx or .csv file here, or choose one (up to 10 MB, 20,000 rows).
connectorCsv.linkSheetHint: Share the sheet first: Share, then Anyone with the link. Add #gid=... to read a specific tab.
connectorCsv.linkDocHint: Share the document with anyone who has the link.
connectorCsv.docsPrompt: Drop .docx, .pdf, .txt or .md files here, or choose them (up to 10 MB each).
connectorCsv.docsOr: Or read a Google Docs document instead.
connectorCsv.docsNote: A file with the same name replaces the earlier one.
connectorCsv.pasteHint: Copy cells in Excel or Google Sheets and paste. The first row holds the column names.
connectorCsv.gridTooBig: The table is large. Use a file for more than 1,000 rows.
connectorCsv.mapMissing: These columns are missing from the new data: {columns}. Choose the replacement columns below, or go back and upload the right file.
connectorCsv.mapIntro: Check how the columns are read. The first rows are shown below.
connectorCsv.mapIdHint: Rows with the same id are updated instead of added again. The row number is used when no column is unique.
connectorCsv.importSkipped: {n} rows without an id were skipped.
connectorCsv.needSheetEmpty: The grid has no rows yet.
connectorCsv.tooBig: That file is larger than 10 MB.

connectorDatabase.title: Add a connection: business database
connectorDatabase.readOnlyBody: Create a dedicated database user that can only SELECT from the tables you want to share. NIVO only reads, but a read-only user keeps it that way whatever happens.
connectorDatabase.fieldHostHint: A public host name or IP address. Servers on a private network cannot be reached.
connectorDatabase.passwordSaved: A password is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
connectorDatabase.tablesHint: Pick the tables to bring in. For each one choose what the rows are, the column that identifies a row, and the columns to bring (at most {max}).
connectorDatabase.colIdHint: Unique per row, so a re-sync updates the same row.
connectorDatabase.colUpdatedHint: Optional. With it, each sync reads only rows changed since the last one.
connectorDatabase.colCap: Only the first {max} columns are brought.
connectorDatabase.limitNote: Each sync reads up to {rows} rows per table.
connectorDatabase.scheduleHint: NIVO reads the database on this schedule. You can also sync by hand from the connection list.
connectorDatabase.agentTitle: Which agents may read this data
connectorDatabase.badPort: The port must be from 1 to 65535.

connectorImap.intro: NIVO reads this mailbox and nothing else: it never sends, moves, flags or deletes a message.
connectorImap.fieldNameHint: A label only you see, for example Support mailbox.
connectorImap.fieldUserHint: Usually the same as the email address.
connectorImap.passwordHint: Gmail and Outlook do not accept your normal password here. Turn on 2-Step Verification, create an app password named NIVO and paste it. The password is stored encrypted and never shown again.
connectorImap.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved password.
connectorImap.imapOn: IMAP must be turned on in the mailbox settings. In Gmail: Settings, Forwarding and POP/IMAP, Enable IMAP.
connectorImap.guideGmail: Gmail: open Google Account, Security, App passwords, create one named NIVO and paste its 16 characters. App passwords need 2-Step Verification.
connectorImap.guideOutlook: Outlook or Office 365: create an app password in your Microsoft account security settings. A work account may need the admin to allow IMAP sign-in.
connectorImap.guideZoho: Zoho: with two-factor sign-in on, create an app password in Zoho Accounts, Security, App passwords.
connectorImap.guideYahoo: Yahoo: create an app password in Account security, Generate app password.
connectorImap.guideOther: Ask your mail provider for the IMAP server, port and whether it needs an app password.
connectorImap.starttlsWarn: STARTTLS starts unencrypted and upgrades; NIVO refuses to continue if the server does not upgrade. Choose TLS on port 993 when you can.
connectorImap.testStale: The settings changed. Check the connection again.
connectorImap.errHost: The server address is not valid.
connectorImap.errPort: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
connectorImap.foldersHint: INBOX is ticked by default. Pick other folders if you want them too.
connectorImap.sinceTitle: How far back on the first sync
connectorImap.sinceHint: Only mail from this period is read the first time; after that, only new mail.
connectorImap.scheduleHint: How often NIVO looks for new mail.
connectorImap.agentSaved: The mailbox is saved. New mail appears after the first sync.
connectorImap.agentTitle: Agents that may read this mailbox

connectorCrm.otherHint: A CRM no package supports yet: you give its CRM id and Swagger link.
connectorCrm.fieldCrmIdHint: 2 to 31 characters: lower-case letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter. For example shopcrm.
connectorCrm.fieldSwaggerUrlHint: The link of the CRM's openapi.json. NIVO fetches it again every time you save.
connectorCrm.fieldBaseUrlHint: NIVO calls the CRM's API at this address (https).
connectorCrm.secretHint: Write only: NIVO never shows the key again after saving.
connectorCrm.secretSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep the current key.
connectorCrm.resultReady: {ready} of {needed} APIs the installed packages need are ready.
connectorCrm.resultNoNeeds: No package calls this CRM yet. {count} other APIs in the Swagger are ready for screens and MCP.
connectorCrm.resultMissingAlert: Saved, but the Swagger lacks some APIs
connectorCrm.resultMissingTitle: APIs the packages need that the Swagger lacks
connectorCrm.driftTitle: The CRM's Swagger differs from the package's document. Missing compared with the package's document:
connectorCrm.apiLead: APIs generated from the CRM's Swagger, read only. Each API has one name: nivo.api.crm.<CRM id>.<method>.<path>.
connectorCrm.snapshotNone: This connection has pinned no Swagger yet.
connectorCrm.repinHint: NIVO fetches the CRM's live Swagger again and pins the new snapshot. The stored key is kept.
connectorCrm.readinessNoNeeds: No package calls this CRM yet
connectorCrm.detail_crm_id_invalid: The CRM id is not valid: use 2 to 31 characters, lower-case letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter.
connectorCrm.detail_auth_type_mismatch: The way the key is sent does not match the package that supports this CRM.
connectorCrm.detail_swagger_unreachable: The Swagger could not be fetched. Check the link and try again.
connectorCrm.detail_too_large: The Swagger file is too large to pin.
connectorCrm.detail_https_required: The address must start with https://.
connectorCrm.detail_private_host: The address points into a private network, so NIVO cannot call it.
connectorCrm.detail_base_path_invalid: The base path in the Swagger is not valid.
connectorCrm.detail_connector_taken: Another connection of this workspace already uses this CRM id.
connectorCrm.detail_not_json: The Swagger file must be JSON (openapi.json).
connectorCrm.detail_swagger_2: This is Swagger 2.0. NIVO needs OpenAPI 3.x.
connectorCrm.detail_key_not_in_header: The key must be sent as a Bearer token or in a header.
connectorCrm.detail_workspace_header_invalid: The header that carries the workspace id is not valid.

connectorTelegramUser.notConfiguredTitle: Personal Telegram is not set up on this NIVO yet
connectorTelegramUser.notConfiguredBody: The administrator needs to add TELEGRAM_API_ID and TELEGRAM_API_HASH (from my.telegram.org) to the server settings first.
connectorTelegramUser.nameHint: For example: Sales account of Lan.
connectorTelegramUser.consent1: NIVO reads only the chats you pick in the next steps.
connectorTelegramUser.consent2: NIVO never sends messages, never deletes anything and never marks chats as read.
connectorTelegramUser.consent3: Anyone holding this session could read the account, so NIVO keeps it encrypted. Disconnecting deletes it. You can also end it yourself in Telegram, Settings, Devices.
connectorTelegramUser.phoneHint: With country code, for example +84912345678. A number starting with 0 is read as Vietnamese.
connectorTelegramUser.codeSentApp: Telegram sent a code to the Telegram app on your other devices.
connectorTelegramUser.codeSentSms: Telegram sent a code by text message.
connectorTelegramUser.codeHint: The code stays valid for a few minutes. NIVO does not store it.
connectorTelegramUser.passwordTitle: Two-step verification is on for this account
connectorTelegramUser.passwordHint: Used once to sign in. NIVO does not store it.
connectorTelegramUser.chatsHint: Tick up to {max} chats. Only these are read and stored.
connectorTelegramUser.scheduleLabel: How often to read new messages
connectorTelegramUser.scheduleHint: Each run reads at most 200 new messages per chat.
connectorTelegramUser.agentTitle: Agents that may read these messages
connectorTelegramUser.errPhone: The phone number is not valid.

developers.title: Developers
developers.description: Connect NIVO to n8n, Make, Zapier or your own tools. For owners and managers.
developers.forbiddenBody: This page holds keys that open your shop's data. Ask your owner if you need it.
developers.eventsBody: When something happens in the shop (a new customer, a won deal, a payment), NIVO posts a signed message to the address you choose, so your tools can carry on from there.
developers.newKeyWarn: The key is shown only once and stored hashed, so it cannot be read again. Copy it now.
developers.keysEmpty: No keys yet. Create one when a tool needs it.
developers.inactiveHolderNotManager: Suspended: the key holder is no longer a manager
developers.inactiveHolderGone: Suspended: the key holder left the workspace
developers.revokeAsk: Revoke "{name}"? Tools using it stop working right away.
developers.guideIntro: Base address: {base}. Send the key in the Authorization header. Each key may make 60 requests a minute. An error answer has a code and a message.
developers.knowledgePostNote: Knowledge added by API is always internal; customers read only public documents an owner approved. Answers 202 with an id; the knowledge is read and indexed within seconds.
developers.pullNote: Pull-based option: ask for what happened since a time, as often as you like.
developers.keyCreated: The API key was created. Copy it now: it is shown only once.
developers.createBody: One key per tool, so you can cut one off without breaking the others.
developers.claudeIntro: Let Claude read and work with the workspace data and agents through MCP. Every call runs with the rights of the key holder.
developers.claudeCodeNote: Run this command in a terminal; replace the placeholder at the end with your key.
developers.kindMcpHint: For Claude and other AI tools; runs with the rights of the key holder.
developers.kindPublicApiHint: For n8n, Make, Zapier or your own software; only owners and managers can make one.
developers.scopeMcpWorkspace: Whole workspace, with the rights of the key holder
developers.scopeMcpAgent: Sees only the agent {name} and its workflows
developers.scopeMcpAgentUnnamed: Sees only one agent and its workflows
developers.scopeMcpAgentHint: Sees only this agent and its workflows

developers.scopeApiAgentUnnamed: One agent owns the conversations opened through the API
developers.scopeApiAgentHint: Owns the conversations opened through the API
developers.scopeApiLabel: Agent that owns the conversations opened through the API
developers.claudeAddressNoKey: The MCP address appears once you make your first MCP key.
developers.claudeAddressUnset: This server has not published an MCP address.
developers.mcpJsonNote: Put the key in the NIVO_API_KEY environment variable and save .mcp.json in the project folder.
developers.connectorsNote: Claude Desktop and claude.ai connectors need OAuth sign-in, which is coming later. For now use Claude Code.
developers.dataNote: Text customers wrote (names, messages, run results) that Claude reads is data, not instructions.

email.err_email: That email address is not valid.
email.err_not_connected: Send a test email successfully first.

email.prefilled: Filled in for you: server {host}, port {port}, {security}.

knowledge.suggest_about_hint: Who you are, what you do, who you serve, where.
knowledge.suggest_offerings_hint: If you sell to customers: items and prices or how you quote.
knowledge.suggest_faq_hint: What customers often ask and the answers you want used.
knowledge.suggest_hours_location_hint: Opening hours, days off, address, how to reach you.
knowledge.suggest_who_handles_hint: Who takes which kind of handoff and how to reach them.
knowledge.suggest_qualification_hint: Criteria for good-fit leads and leads to drop.
knowledge.suggest_approval_process_hint: What you approve, from what amount, and who covers for you.
knowledge.suggest_payment_methods_hint: Receiving account, transfer reference, usual payment terms.
knowledge.suggest_booking_services_hint: One line per service: name, duration, price. E.g. Men’s haircut, 45 min, 150,000đ; Colour, 120 min, from 600,000đ.
knowledge.suggest_booking_cancellation_hint: When a deposit is due and how much, what late cancellation costs, how many reschedules. E.g. 30% deposit above 500,000đ; refunded if cancelled 24h ahead.
knowledge.suggest_booking_resources_topic: Staff, rooms and equipment that can be booked
knowledge.suggest_booking_resources_hint: Who or what takes bookings, which services each can do, max parallel guests, buffer between slots. E.g. Lan does nails and lashes; room 2 massage only; 10 min buffer.
knowledge.suggest_booking_exceptions_topic: Booking hours, days off and exceptions
knowledge.suggest_booking_exceptions_hint: Regular booking hours, holidays closed or changed, days staff are away. E.g. Mon-Sat 9:00-20:00; closed 30 Apr and 1 May.
knowledge.suggest_loyalty_points_hint: How much spend earns how many points, multipliers, daily or per-order caps. E.g. 10,000đ = 1 point; double on birthdays; no points on voucher orders.
knowledge.suggest_loyalty_rewards_hint: One line per reward: name, points, conditions, stock. E.g. Free drink, 100 points; 50,000đ voucher, 250 points, valid 30 days.
knowledge.suggest_loyalty_tiers_hint: Tier names, how to reach and keep each, perks per tier. E.g. Silver from 0; Gold from 2,000 points a year, 5% off, priority booking.
knowledge.suggest_loyalty_expiry_hint: When points expire, how members are warned, when points are removed. E.g. expire after 12 months idle; refunded orders reverse earned points.
knowledge.suggest_hiring_roles_hint: Per role: main duties, must-have and nice-to-have, place, type. E.g. Cashier, full time, District 1, POS skills, F&B experience a plus.
knowledge.suggest_hiring_process_hint: Each stage, who runs it, how long, pass criteria. E.g. CV screen (2 days), phone screen, manager interview, trial shift, offer within 3 days.
knowledge.suggest_hiring_benefits_hint: What candidates can be told: bonus, insurance, leave, training, probation. E.g. 2-month probation at 85%; insurance after probation; 13th-month bonus.
knowledge.suggest_hiring_salary_bands_hint: Pay band per role and the negotiation ceiling. Internal only, never shared with candidates or customers; keep it Restricted in the Brain. E.g. Cashier 7-9M.
knowledge.suggest_content_pillars_hint: 3-5 fixed themes, share of each, target audience. E.g. Tips (40%), Behind the scenes (20%), Customer stories (20%), Offers (20%); aimed at mums 25-35.
knowledge.suggest_content_banned_claims_hint: Words and promises not allowed, competitors not to name, industry rules. E.g. never ’cures’, ’number 1’, ’100% guaranteed’; no brand comparisons.
knowledge.suggest_content_offers_calendar_hint: Upcoming offers, holidays and events by date with conditions. E.g. 20 Oct 15% off; 11 Nov buy 2 get 1; second branch opens 1 Dec.
knowledge.suggest_content_channels_cadence_hint: Where to post, posts per week, times, what needs your approval. E.g. Facebook 4 a week at 19:00; TikTok 2 videos; posts with prices need approval.
knowledge.suggest_video_brand_kit_hint: Logo, main colours, fonts, music dos and don’ts, aspect ratios. E.g. colour #0F766E; logo bottom right; vertical 9:16 under 30s.
knowledge.suggest_video_offers_hint: Products or offers to push, their dates, the call to action. E.g. afternoon tea combo 99,000đ until 31 Oct; CTA: message us on Zalo to book.
knowledge.suggest_video_claims_hint: What a video must not promise, banned imagery, who approves before posting. E.g. no weight-loss promises, no customer photos without consent; owner approves every video.
knowledge.suggest_lead_icp_hint: Who is worth pursuing: age, job, area, budget, the problem they have. E.g. owners of 1-3 cafés in HCMC, budget 5-20M a month.
knowledge.suggest_lead_questions_hint: A few ordered questions to understand need, one at a time. E.g. Which service? Rough budget? Needed by when? Best number to call?
knowledge.suggest_lead_scoring_hint: Signals for each level and the next step. E.g. Hot = leaves a number and asks price or dates, call within 15 min; Warm = interested, no budget yet, follow up in a day; Cold = browsing, nurture.
knowledge.suggest_lead_objections_hint: Common pushbacks and the reply you want. E.g. ’Too expensive’: explain value, offer a smaller package; ’Let me think’: agree a day to follow up.
knowledge.suggest_lead_offers_hint: Prices and offers that may be shared openly, with dates and conditions. E.g. starter pack 2,990,000đ; 10% off for the first 20 customers in October; free consultation.
knowledge.suggest_lead_forbidden_claims_hint: Promises, comparisons and results never to state to prospects. E.g. no promised revenue growth; no unpublished prices; no knocking competitors.
knowledge.suggest_lead_routing_topic: Working hours and who receives leads
knowledge.suggest_lead_routing_hint: Call-back hours, who gets hot leads, what happens out of hours. E.g. Huong takes leads 8-18h; after 18h promise a call at 8am; hot leads ping the owner on Zalo.

smtpPresets.google_workspace_blurb: Email like name@company.com hosted by Google.
smtpPresets.google_workspace_app_password_when: Choose this if you are the shop owner and not a Google Workspace admin. Takes about 2 minutes.
smtpPresets.google_workspace_app_password_passwordHi: Paste the 16 characters Google created, with or without spaces.
smtpPresets.google_workspace_app_password_step1: Turn on 2-Step Verification for the Google account (required to create an app password).
smtpPresets.google_workspace_app_password_step2: Open App passwords, name it NIVO and press Create.
smtpPresets.google_workspace_app_password_step3: Google shows 16 characters. Copy them and paste into the Password box on the next step. Google shows them only once.
smtpPresets.google_workspace_app_password_step4: If App passwords is missing, your Workspace admin has turned it off. Ask them to allow it, or use the SMTP relay mode.
smtpPresets.google_workspace_app_password_caution1: Google Workspace allows about 2,000 emails per day per user.
smtpPresets.google_workspace_relay_when: Choose this only if you are a Workspace admin and the sending server has a fixed IP address. NIVO runs on shared servers, so this usually does NOT fit; if unsure, pick App password.
smtpPresets.google_workspace_relay_passwordLabel: Password (leave empty if you authenticate by IP)
smtpPresets.google_workspace_relay_passwordHint: The relay normally authenticates by IP address and needs no password.
smtpPresets.google_workspace_relay_step1: In the Google Admin console open Apps > Google Workspace > Gmail > Routing.
smtpPresets.google_workspace_relay_step2: SMTP relay service: press Add, allow the sending IP address and tick Require TLS encryption.
smtpPresets.google_workspace_relay_caution1: Each user can relay up to 10,000 recipients per day.
smtpPresets.gmail_app_password_when: The only way for personal Gmail. Do not use your Gmail login password.
smtpPresets.gmail_app_password_passwordHint: Paste the 16 characters Google created, with or without spaces.
smtpPresets.gmail_app_password_step1: Turn on 2-Step Verification for the Google account (required to create an app password).
smtpPresets.gmail_app_password_step2: Open App passwords, name it NIVO and press Create.
smtpPresets.gmail_app_password_step3: Google shows 16 characters. Copy them and paste into the Password box on the next step. Google shows them only once.
smtpPresets.gmail_app_password_caution1: Personal Gmail should send about 500 emails per day. Beyond that Google pauses sending. Fine for reports and receipts, not for bulk mail.
smtpPresets.microsoft365_blurb: Company email on Microsoft 365, or Outlook.
smtpPresets.microsoft365_smtp_auth_when: Send from the Microsoft 365 mailbox itself.
smtpPresets.microsoft365_smtp_auth_passwordHint: The sending mailbox's password. With multi-factor sign-in you need an app password or an admin exception.
smtpPresets.microsoft365_smtp_auth_step1: Ask your Microsoft 365 admin to enable SMTP AUTH for the sending mailbox (Admin center > Users > pick the user > Mail > Manage email apps > Authenticated SMTP).
smtpPresets.microsoft365_smtp_auth_step2: Come back here and enter that mailbox's address and password.
smtpPresets.microsoft365_smtp_auth_caution1: Microsoft is retiring basic authentication for SMTP in many tenants. If a test says wrong password although it is right, your tenant may be blocked; use Google, Zoho or a mail service instead.
smtpPresets.microsoft365_smtp_auth_caution2: Limit is about 30 messages per minute and 10,000 recipients per day.
smtpPresets.zoho_blurb: Free Zoho mail or a paid custom-domain mailbox.
smtpPresets.zoho_custom_domain_when: An address like name@company.com on Zoho.
smtpPresets.zoho_custom_domain_passwordHint: With two-factor sign-in, create an app-specific password in Zoho Accounts.
smtpPresets.zoho_custom_domain_step1: If two-factor is on, open Zoho Accounts > Security > App passwords and create one named NIVO.
smtpPresets.zoho_custom_domain_step2: Enter the Zoho address and password on the next step. The sender must be this account's address or alias.
smtpPresets.zoho_custom_domain_caution1: Zoho accounts in other data centres (zoho.eu, zoho.in) use another host, for example smtppro.zoho.eu. Not fully verified.
smtpPresets.zoho_personal_passwordHint: With two-factor sign-in, create an app-specific password in Zoho Accounts.
smtpPresets.zoho_personal_step1: Enter the Zoho address and password (or app-specific password) on the next step.
smtpPresets.vn_hosting_title: Vietnamese email hosting (Mat Bao, PA Vietnam, Nhan Hoa…)
smtpPresets.vn_hosting_blurb: Domain email bought from a local hosting provider.
smtpPresets.vn_hosting_hosting_when: Each provider has its own server. Find the outgoing (SMTP) server and port in the email they sent when you opened the service, or in the mailbox settings page.
smtpPresets.vn_hosting_hosting_passwordHint: The password you use for this mailbox's webmail.
smtpPresets.vn_hosting_hosting_step1: Open the provider's welcome email or mailbox page and find the mail client settings (Outlook, Thunderbird).
smtpPresets.vn_hosting_hosting_step2: Copy the Outgoing server (SMTP) and Port. Often mail.yourdomain.vn, port 587 (STARTTLS) or 465 (SSL). The username is usually the full email address.
smtpPresets.vn_hosting_hosting_caution1: Some hosts cap emails per hour (often a few hundred). Ask the provider if you need more.
smtpPresets.relay_service_title: Mail sending service (Resend, SendGrid, Amazon SES)
smtpPresets.relay_service_blurb: For higher volume and reliability. You must verify the sending domain.
smtpPresets.relay_service_resend_passwordHint: Your Resend API key (starts with re_).
smtpPresets.relay_service_resend_step1: Create a Resend account and verify your sending domain.
smtpPresets.relay_service_resend_step2: Create an API key, copy it and paste it into the API key box.
smtpPresets.relay_service_resend_caution1: The from address must be on the verified domain.
smtpPresets.relay_service_sendgrid_when: The username is always the word apikey.
smtpPresets.relay_service_sendgrid_passwordHint: A SendGrid API key with Mail Send permission (starts with SG.).
smtpPresets.relay_service_sendgrid_step1: Complete Sender Authentication for your sending address or domain.
smtpPresets.relay_service_sendgrid_step2: Create an API key with Mail Send permission, copy it and paste it here.
smtpPresets.relay_service_ses_when: Needs an AWS account. The SMTP password is NOT your AWS secret key.
smtpPresets.relay_service_ses_passwordHint: The SMTP username and password SES generates (Create SMTP credentials).
smtpPresets.relay_service_ses_step1: In SES, open SMTP settings and press Create SMTP credentials; copy the username and password (shown once).
smtpPresets.relay_service_ses_step2: The host looks like email-smtp.<region>.amazonaws.com; change the region to yours.
smtpPresets.relay_service_ses_caution1: A new SES account is in sandbox: it can only send to verified addresses until AWS lifts it.
